comment: Canonical ElevenLabs casting for the Release 1.6 LOUD voice pack (MISSING-AUDIO.md). Reuse these exact voice_ids and settings for every retake so the cast stays consistent. Voice settings are per performance class; eleven_v3 stability accepts only 0.0 (creative), 0.5 (natural), 1.0 (robust).

announcer.direction: Deep, gritty arena MC. Short punchy takes, hard consonants.

deathblow.direction: Seismic bruiser-grappler. Gravel-deep chest voice, slow monster grunts.

jez.direction: Blue-gi signsmith. Confident mid-range martial artist, crisp kiai energy, slightly playful.

alan.direction: South Philly heavyweight counter-puncher. Thick Philly accent, gruff bar-brawler low bark.

post.direction: Spray-can graffiti zoner. Young, cocky, nasal street-punk; quick taunting edge, raspy.

benny.direction: Street technician, electrical rushdown. Wiry and fast; clipped, crackling shouts.

donald.direction: Gilded showman. Brash bluster, self-satisfied drawl, showman projection.

cyraxx.direction: Feedback trickster. Unhinged chaos gremlin; cracking falsetto shrieks, distorted edges.

ali.direction: West Staines MC, rhythm fighter. Mock-hip-hop swagger; rhythmic ad-lib energy.

commissioner.direction: Aged Philadelphia power broker. Deep, dry, unhurried gravel; contempt, not rage; courtroom cadence.

devil.direction: Screechy South-Jersey cryptid. Raptor screeches and goat-bleat breaks over a dry unimpressed local drawl. Loudest voice in the cast.
